The plate is a square white plate, about 22–24 cm across. The photo is cropped, so only part of it shows.

Scrambled egg whites cover roughly 55% of the visible plate. The pile is about 2–3 cm high, so I estimate about 150 g.

The cantaloupe or papaya chunks sit on the right. There are about 8 cubes of roughly 3 cm each, around 25 g per cube, which gives about 160 g. The yellow pieces at the top look like pineapple or yellow papaya, perhaps 3 pieces at about 25 g each, or about 70 g.
